comment: Decision nodes harvested from recorded AI playthroughs (docs/PLAYTEST_PERSONAS.md, 'The decision harvest'). The policy engine in test_runner_cli.gd implements each node's logic; this file is the registry — which nodes exist, who uses them, and the trace that taught us each one. Grow it one playthrough at a time.

nodes.rule: Before committing to any route, hold at cover and sample every threat's walk until it stops surprising you (its observed extents stop growing).
Patrol reach = walk line + detect + pursuit. Never extrapolate from partial samples; a dash is only legal once the loop is known.
A committed striker (windup/charge/impact/recover) is not tracking you: abort the leg and break for the nearest cover while it is busy.
Run watched ground, walk safe ground; never start a watched leg below the stamina it costs.
A Capbage conceals one body; route the party across hides one leaf each, or accept exposed escorts.
nodes.source: pump_hall_ai_2026-07-31 #19 (two members parked beside the leaf)

nodes.rule: When a room's owner stands at the far end of its observed walk, the window is open NOW — go; waiting for better spends it.
A commit needs a settled body, a SELECTED character, standing within the interaction radius. Walk the actor to the console, wait a beat, then fire.
The far post is only a window when the walk is heading AWAY - launching into a turnaround meets the sweep head-on. Heading beats distance.
nodes.source: sprint_gap_eazy_2026-07-31 #0-#10 (launched into the turn; windup at arm's length)

nodes.rule: Party members drain differently - check EVERY bar before a party sprint; the slowest bar sets the plan.
nodes.source: sprint_gap_eazy_2026-07-31 (endo's bar hit zero on a leg the leader funded)

nodes.rule: A downed member costs the retrieve round-trip under watch plus the revive wait - always slower than the window you tried to skip.
A scarpet sheds an outer-range watcher, not a pursuer - once spotted, do not hold cover on the watch line; break instead.
nodes.source: sprint_gap_eazy_2026-07-31 (the watcher walked over the scarpet in pursuit)

nodes.rule: A sanctuary revive leaves the body in its own rest, which blocks the group bed-down - nudge everyone awake, settle, then commit the rest.
nodes.retired: 2026-07-31: the party rest now ABSORBS an in-shelter solo rester (director's pick; the sanctuary-revive rest yields to the group bed-down). Kept as history - the trace that motivated the rule change.
